authority_note: Compiled by hand from docs/OWNER_APPROVED_ROADMAP_2026-10-25.md (owner-approved, standing development authorization). The roadmap states what to achieve; slices are bounded, ordered steps toward it.

capabilities.capability: One user request orchestrates online source discovery, retrieval, evidence analysis, citation verification and a structured Research Report; research runs locally with online sources fetched on demand and Ollama optional.
completion_evidence: docs/OWNER_APPROVED_ROADMAP_2026-10-25.md Research Report v1 and Next slices

slices.objective: Identify local-corpus and Ollama hard dependencies in the existing orchestration and pin them in tests.
acceptance: docs/roadmap/ai_corpus_ollama_dependency_audit.md lists each hard dependency with file references
a test shows the default orchestration path does not require a local corpus or Ollama
Canonical preflight, required CI checks and review must pass at the exact head; no gate may be weakened.

slices.objective: Implement an online-evidence adapter and report orchestration behind the existing contracts.
acceptance: the adapter consumes Core's online evidence bundle and yields source-grounded claims with explicit uncertainty
intermediate artifacts are bounded and cleaned up and no permanent bulk document storage is added
Canonical preflight, required CI checks and review must pass at the exact head; no gate may be weakened.

slices.objective: Test a single-request report end to end, including missing or contradictory sources and citation validation.
acceptance: a test covers missing sources, contradictory sources and citation validation
claims without verifiable citations are rejected or marked uncertain
Canonical preflight, required CI checks and review must pass at the exact head; no gate may be weakened.
